name: TAL bHLH transcription factor 1, erythroid differentiation factor

function.text: TAL1 encodes t-cell acute lymphocytic leukemia protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of chromatin organization.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
